snippet.title: The Defiant - Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Stories from Chinese battlefields of World War II are coming to life in The Defiant, a first-person-shooter detailing the struggles Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army, the Canal Detachment, and more of China's War of Resistance. Wishlist now on Steam, PS5, Xbox Series X/S.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom
